pack.name: windows-lab
pack.description: Windows endpoint conditions: process relationships, persistence, authentication, network, integrity and coverage gaps (synthetic telemetry).

scenarios.title: Command shell under the IIS worker process
scenarios.description: w3wp.exe is the parent of cmd.exe.
scenarios.objective: HPRC-001 detects a shell under a network-facing service on Windows.

cleanup.description: Synthetic dataset: nothing is created on any host.

limitations: Synthetic telemetry shaped like the Windows collector's output; it shows the rule's logic, not how a real host behaves.
Names are lower-cased by the collector; the rule's server list is not exhaustive.
